summary: This is a Form 6-K filed by Brookfield Property Partners L.P., a foreign private issuer, reporting a press release dated April 30, 2026. The press release announces the declaration of quarterly distributions on its listed preferred units — no special situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change is involved. The filing is a routine dividend declaration for four series of preferred units (BPYPP, BPYPO, BPYPN, BPYPM) with amounts ranging from $0.359375 to $0.40625 per unit, payable on June 30, 2026, to holders of record on June 1, 2026. No special meeting or extraordinary action is referenced. This is an ordinary-course distribution announcement and does not constitute a special situation.
